title: In This Town, Every Time You Sneeze, a House Moves
description: Every sneeze moves a house in my town. I'm allergic to EVERYTHING. Say bless you in the comments…

scenes.narration: In this town, every time someone sneezes, a random house drives to a new spot.
Most people sneeze maybe twice a month. That's two houses. No big deal.
I'm allergic to *everything*. Pollen. Cats. Dust. My own pillow.
My mom keeps tissues in every room. My dad sleeps with the car keys under his pillow, just in case our house leaves without him.
On my first day of school, I sneezed four times. The school ended up next to the bakery. Nobody complained.
By spring, my best friend Max lived on the beach. He didn't even move. His house just showed up there.
The mayor called an emergency meeting. Everyone was looking at *me*.
So I tried everything. A mask. Nothing. Pills. Nothing. I even held my breath for a whole minute.
Then came pollen season. The fields turned yellow. And my nose started to *tingle*.
I sneezed *forty-two* times in a row.
Houses everywhere. The town hall rolled into the sea. The mayor was still inside, holding his coffee.
I was sure they would kick me out of town forever.
Instead, tourists started coming from all over the world. Just to watch the houses drive around.
Now I'm the town's main attraction. And the mayor? He loves his new ocean view.
Say *bless you* in the comments. Or your house might be next.
